content: Hey team, I noticed that our login page is taking more than 5 seconds to load for some users.
Thanks for flagging that, Alice. Do we know which browsers or devices are affected?
It seems to be happening mostly on Chrome, especially on mobile devices.
I can confirm this issue. I tested on my Android phone with Chrome and it took around 7 seconds to load.
Has anyone checked the server logs? Maybe there's an API bottleneck.
Good point. I'll check the logs and see if there's anything unusual during login requests.
This is definitely a critical issue since it affects our user experience. We should prioritize fixing it.
